sentences.text:
The learned Addl. P.P. has raised objections stating that the applicant was directed to appear before the trial Court vide order dated 08.12.2021 within 15 (fifteen) days but now, the applicant/petitioner has filed this application on 06.06.2023 with prayer for extension of time to appear before the trial Court from 08.12.2021.
4.
The medical documents in support of which, the petitioner has prayed for extension of time is marked as Annexure-4.

The petitioner was advised bed rest for 2(two) weeks and RV after 2(two)
weeks on 07.12.2021, as he was suffering from fever since 5 days.

The order dated 08.12.2021 reflects that the applicant's prayer for anticipatory bail was dismissed with a direction to him to appear before the learned Court below within 15 (fifteen) days and seek regular bail, if so advised.

5. The interim order passed by this Court on 22.09.2021 was then extended for 15 (fifteen) days in connection with Howly P.S. Case No. 69/2021, registered under sections 120(B)/417/342/376 IPC.
6.
The ground stated by the petitioner for extension of period w.e.f 08.12.2021 does not appear to be reasonable, so the application is rejected at this stage of investigation.
7. In view of above observations, this interlocutory application stands disposed of.
